The Geely EX5 is certainly cheap, but is it better than what the leading German manufacturers have to offer?

Mat’s got his hands on the Geely EX5! 

It’s a luxurious-feeling, family-sized electric SUV that has class-leading German SUVs such as the Volkswagen ID4 and Audi Q4 e-tron in its sights! 

The question is, should you choose this all-new Chinese SUV over its more established rivals? Let’s take a closer look.. 

Starting with the design, it has a fairly inoffensive look and feel from the outside. The £800 paint on the model we’re reviewing certainly helps it stand out, but otherwise it’s relatively generic, with smooth curves across the bonnet. Around the side there’s black cladding around the wheel arches, satin roof bars and chrome window surrounds. Around the back, the design is again relatively nondescript, although we can’t help but see some Macan similarities!
